title: Place des Montréalaises / Lemay + Angela Silver + AtkinsRéalis
text:
Place des Montréalaises / Lemay + Angela Silver + AtkinsRéalis

Place des Montréalaises: A Monumental Gesture Inscribing Women's Memory at the Heart of a City
Place des Montréalaises is reshaping Montreal's civic and tourist heart by covering a sunken expressway with a vibrant esplanade. Designed by Lemay in collaboration with artist Angela Silver and the engineering team at AtkinsRéalis, this major intervention connects Old Montreal to downtown and inscribes the memory of exceptional women in the urban landscape.

title: Preistoriche Green Lodge  / Studio Apostoli
text:
Preistoriche Green Lodge / Studio Apostoli

An eco-friendly approach to hospitality, in full respect of the region and its preexisting elements: the new Green Lodges of the Terme Preistoriche Resort & Spa in Montegrotto Terme (PD), designed by Studio Apostoli, is meant to be a manifesto of zero-emission wellness hospitality. Seven suites are incorporated into four wooden stilted structures and interconnected through a raised system of ramps, walkways, and accessible terraces. They also include a historically preserved villa, the eighth and most extensive offering within this entrepreneurial endeavor. 160 micro piles support the new constructions and outdoor spaces, preserving the roots of the age-old trees. Alberto Apostoli, the founder of the Verona-based studio responsible for the development, meticulously mapped these trees before outlining any project proposals.

title: Call for Entries: The New Heart of Kraaiennest with OBA Next (Amsterdam)
text:
Call for Entries: The New Heart of Kraaiennest with OBA Next (Amsterdam)

The City of Amsterdam is holding an international design competition for the project ‘The New Heart of Kraaiennest with OBA Next’. The purpose of the procurement procedure is to select a design team. The assignment calls for a cohesive design addressing the public realm, civic and community facilities, socioeconomic growth, and the spatial integration of the housing programme. Essential to the assignment is the integration of urban design, landscape, architecture and socioeconomic value.

The full programme for the competition comprises the following spatial components:
• OBA Next library
• Youth centre
• Huis van de Wijk
• Rehearsal space
• Complementary neighbourhood programme
• Housing and facilities

title: Mapping Memory: Reconstructing Architecture Beyond Physical Evidence
text:
Mapping Memory: Reconstructing Architecture Beyond Physical Evidence

How do you remember the dimensions of a room you could barely see? Perhaps through the distance between footsteps, the sound of a door closing, or the way an echo travels down a corridor. For someone who has been denied the ability to see or move freely through a space, these fragments may be the only record of its architecture.

title: Pod for Happiness / Craft Narrative
text:
Pod for Happiness / Craft Narrative

In the small village of Hignigada near Baramati, Maharashtra, a young village head approached us to build an outdoor play area for school children. The school campus had a large playground divided by an avenue of seven trees, with classrooms arranged along the perimeter. Villagers fondly shared how they enjoyed evening walks and sitting under the trees. Inspired by this connection to nature & community space, we designed the play area around the banyan tree, making it the centerpiece of the insert.

title: The Living Mosque: 5 Winning Projects Announced by the Abdullatif Al Fozan Award for Mosque Architecture
text:
The Living Mosque: 5 Winning Projects Announced by the Abdullatif Al Fozan Award for Mosque Architecture

The Abdullatif Al Fozan Award for Mosque Architecture has announced the winners of its fifth cycle (2023–2026), recognizing five projects in Bangladesh, the United Kingdom, Oman, Niger, and Indonesia, alongside two Special Recognition Award recipients: the Mohammed bin Salman Project for Developing Historic Mosques in Saudi Arabia and Djamaâ El-Djazaïr (Great Mosque of Algiers) in Algeria. Established in 2011, the international award recognizes contemporary mosque designs that respond to changing community needs while maintaining a connection to the architectural heritage and principles of Islamic architecture.

title: Kelly Wearstler Studio and ESG Architecture Lead Transformation of Minoru Yamasaki's Minneapolis Building
text:
Kelly Wearstler Studio and ESG Architecture Lead Transformation of Minoru Yamasaki's Minneapolis Building

The proposed conversion of Minoru Yamasaki's former Northwestern National Life Insurance Company headquarters in Minneapolis has advanced with the announcement of its design team, hotel operator, and expanded program. First presented in April 2026, the adaptive reuse project will transform the 1965 building at 20 Washington Avenue South into Minneapolis Proper, a 165-room hotel operated by Proper Hospitality. The project is being developed by Minneapolis-based CDT Realty Corp, with ESG Architecture & Design serving as architect and Kelly Wearstler Studio leading the creative direction. Pending historic approvals, construction is expected to begin in fall 2027, with completion targeted for summer 2029.

title: CHYBÍK + KRIŠTOF Selected to Design a New Arena and Public Park Below Nitra Castle in Slovakia
text:
CHYBÍK + KRIŠTOF Selected to Design a New Arena and Public Park Below Nitra Castle in Slovakia

Brno-based architecture practice CHYBÍK + KRIŠTOF has been selected to design a new arena in Nitra, Slovakia. The practice was announced as one of five finalists in June 2026, alongside BAKYTA architekti and Boele architects in cooperation with DRHA project; PEER COLLECTIVE and NP2F; PLURAL sro and MUOTO in collaboration with Atelier Divo; and N/A. The new multifunctional arena in Nitra will be located beneath Nitra Castle, a national cultural monument, on an existing sports ground between a renovated municipal park at Sihoť and the Nitra River. CHYBÍK + KRIŠTOF's selected proposal turns the site into an open park, with updated infrastructure to host top-flight ice hockey, other indoor sports, and international cultural events. The studio worked with design and research consultancy Marko & Placemakers on the proposal to ensure year-round use of the public spaces.

title: Rainwater and Public Space: Winners of Buildner’s Rome Rain Rooms Competition
text:
Rainwater and Public Space: Winners of Buildner’s Rome Rain Rooms Competition

Buildner has announced the results of Rome Rain Rooms, an international architecture ideas competition inviting designers to reconsider the relationship between rainfall, public space, and the historic city of Rome. The challenge explored how a small urban pavilion could transform water from a resource typically channelled out of sight into an active part of civic life.

title: Villa N&N / SAOTA
text:
Villa N&N / SAOTA

Positioned on the edge of the Ébrié Lagoon, Villa N&N balances privacy with a dynamic connection to its surroundings, offering expansive views toward the Plateau business district's skyline. Reinforcing an architectural language that is both refined and contextually responsive, the villa's design is enriched by nuanced spatial relationships, the interplay of light, and a striking contrast of materials.

title: Large Glass Openings at Work in a Production Facility
text:
Large Glass Openings at Work in a Production Facility

Integrating truck access into a glazed facade requires coordinating panel dimensions, opening mechanisms, and the space needed for vehicles to maneuver. These decisions affect both the composition of the facade and how materials and products move in and out of the building. Glass thus becomes part of the daily workflow: when closed, it encloses the space and admits natural light; when open, it allows loading and unloading to take place.

title: A two-way facade / CYS.ASDO
text:
A two-way facade / CYS.ASDO

The façade addresses two simultaneous relationships: how the city sees the building, and how occupants see the city. Openings in the outer façade and interior enclosure respond to the spaces they serve. Some align to extend views outward; others are offset to redirect sightlines. Walls, terraces, and planting filter the surroundings into selected views.

title: Dream House / Seiro Arquitectos
text:
Dream House / Seiro Arquitectos

Some houses overlook the sea, while others allow you to live at its pace. Casa Ensueño does the latter: a residence conceived as a succession of open, protected, and serene spaces, where the architecture accompanies the shifting light, the movement of the air, and the constant presence of the Pacific Ocean.

title: Cabeceiras do Aricanduva Municipal Natural Park / Natureza Urbana
text:
Cabeceiras do Aricanduva Municipal Natural Park / Natureza Urbana

Located in Cidade Tiradentes, in the eastern zone of São Paulo, the Nascentes Hub of the Cabeceiras do Aricanduva Municipal Natural Park spans an area of approximately 96,000 m², featuring remnants of the Atlantic Forest and the headwaters of the Aricanduva River basin. Developed by Natureza Urbana in partnership with the Department of Implementation, Projects, and Works of the Municipal Secretariat for the Green and the Environment, the project brings the local community closer to this natural heritage while establishing a transition between the neighborhood and the preservation area.

title: Madre Culebra Cabin / Taller Viga Maestra
text:
Madre Culebra Cabin / Taller Viga Maestra

In a clearing of the native forest of the Las Trancas Valley, at the foot of the Andes Mountains, the Madre Culebra Refuge is installed, seeking to occupy the territory with the least possible alteration. Surrounded by trees and facing the extreme conditions of the mountains, the house is conceived as a vertical, compact, and protected shelter, designed for family and friends to gather.

title: Restoration of the Picote Engineers' Houses and Gardens / Cannatà & Fernandes
text:
Restoration of the Picote Engineers' Houses and Gardens / Cannatà & Fernandes

The Picote engineers' houses, built between 1954 and 1957, were designed by the young architect Manuel Nunes de Almeida (1924-2014) within the Projects Office of the Hidroeléctrica do Douro (HED) company. They are situated at an intermediate level between the Pousada building and the housing complex for specialized workers.

title: Anchorage Road Artist Studio / Ballman Khapalova
text:
Anchorage Road Artist Studio / Ballman Khapalova

The Anchorage Road Artist Studio is a 680-square-foot painting studio and office for artist Natasha Sweeten. The goal was to create an economical and efficient building that opened up to north and south light for different tasks, in turn maximizing connection to the surrounding landscape and creating a private, protected space for creative work.

title: North Boulder Library / WORKac
text:
North Boulder Library / WORKac

The Boulder Public Library issued an open Request for Proposal (RFP) in 2018 for a new branch library in North Boulder, a project the community had anticipated for over two decades. The RFP called for an "iconic" building, which many competitors interpreted as a visually striking design. However, WORKac www.work.ac - the architecture firm based in New York City and led by Amale Andraos and Dan Wood - proposed a vision where the library's iconic status would stem from its sustainability and its positive impact on the community and environment.

text:
ROOT / LEVS architecten

title: 15th European Prize of Architecture Philippe Rotthier
text:
15th European Prize of Architecture Philippe Rotthier

The 15th European Prize of Architecture Philippe Rotthier rewards recent architectural achievements, located within urban or rural contexts. The 15th edition of the prize acknowledges the architecture rooted in its context, attentive to history and local know-how, innovative towards the use of resources, aware towards the ecological and social challenges of its context. The prize is endowed with €50,000 and the selected projects will be exhibited in Brussels in 2027.
